entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I need to return something, and I just feel awful about it. I ordered this jersey a while back and I only just now got around to trying it on.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
It's... it's just the wrong size. I must have ordered incorrectly. The jersey is way too tight, and I can't even ride in it. I feel so silly for waiting so long to check.
That happens sometimes, no need to worry. I can definitely look into your options. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-198754. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really was hoping for an exchange, but to be honest, I could really use the money back right now. It would help a lot.
I understand. Let me pull up that order... VF-198754. I'm showing the Pro-Weave Cycling jersey, delivered about 66 days ago. Is that the one?
Yes, that's it. I know it's been a while. I was just so busy... I was so looking forward to wearing it. I'm just so disappointed.
No problem at all. Let me just check the policy for that item. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. That jersey is a standard item, and you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a huge relief. I was so worried I had just wasted my money.

Absolutely. Since it's the wrong size and too tight to wear, we can definitely process a return for a full refund. Did you want to stick with the refund, or would you still like to exchange it for a different size?
A refund would be amazing. Thank you so, so much, David. You have no idea what a help this is.

You are very welcome. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account now. Just pack the jersey in a box, apply the label, and drop it at a post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
